description: Add something used during a stay to the booking's bill: minibar, laundry, a late checkout, damage. Only for guests who are checked in or have left. It adds to what the booking costs (tax as the business has set it), so the guest owes it. Without confirm: true it only shows what would be added and the new balance, so you can check with the person first.

amount.description: The price of one, in normal currency units

confirm.description: Must be true to actually add it

description.description: What it's for, as the guest will see it, e.g. 'Minibar: soft drinks'

name: add_charge
title: Add a charge to a stay
